subject: Apple crate labels
body: The pink lady crates need the new orchard name on the side labels. We can print them here if you send the final wording by Wednesday.

subject: Field walk next week
body: I can meet you at the east gate at 8 on Tuesday. We should look at the drainage along rows C through F before the rain returns.

subject: Arena booking
body: The indoor arena is free after 3 on Sunday. Would you like me to reserve the full hour or just half? The pony club lesson ends at 2.30.

subject: Feed trial results
body: The new pellets sank more slowly in yesterday's tank trial. I have noted the water temperature and feed weights in the lab book. Shall we repeat it on Thursday?

subject: Jar lid colours
body: The amber lids look good with the small batch labels. Please hold one box aside for the shop display and send the rest with the next wholesale order.

subject: Friday stall allocation
body: We have space for two more traders near the west doors. Let me know whether the smoked trout seller is joining us, and I will update the floor plan.

subject: Sourdough order for Monday
body: Could you prepare four rye loaves and six country rounds for collection at 7? I will bring the return trays and pay at the counter as usual.

subject: Blend tasting notes
body: The Peru lot has a brighter finish than last year's crop. Let's cup it beside the house blend on Friday morning and decide whether to feature it in the next newsletter.

subject: Van arrival at Willow Fair
body: We will arrive at the west field around 10.30 to set up. Please confirm there is room beside the power point for the serving hatch to face the footpath.

subject: Table flowers for June
body: The venue has chosen pale yellow and cream for the long tables. I can use seasonal ranunculus if the delivery arrives in time; otherwise we will switch to garden roses.

subject: Rehearsal dinner setup
body: The family would like one long table for twelve and two small round tables nearby. We can put the welcome sign at the courtyard entrance if the weather holds.

subject: Slip inspection
body: Our harbour master can inspect the pontoons on 6 July. Please ask visiting boats to keep the outer finger clear until the work is finished.

subject: Wheel truing pickup
body: The rear wheel is true now and the brake pads have plenty of life left. You can collect the bike any time after lunch tomorrow.

subject: Windscreen appointment
body: The replacement pane is in stock. We can fit it at our depot on Monday morning; please leave the car for about two hours so the seal can set.

subject: Dishwasher part
body: The inlet valve arrived today, so I can return to finish the repair on Thursday. The machine should be empty and switched off when I get there.

subject: Tile sample approval
body: I have left the terracotta sample at the site office. The colour is close to the existing roof, and the profile matches the front porch. Let me know if you approve it.

subject: Kitchen door measurements
body: The two pantry doors measure 410 millimetres each. I will finish the oak edging this week and bring the hinges when we come to fit them.

subject: Bay window survey
body: We can measure the bay next Wednesday at 9. Please clear the sill and move the plant stand so the surveyor can open each sash fully.

subject: Termite inspection reminder
body: Your annual inspection is due in August. The visit takes about 45 minutes, and we will check the perimeter and accessible roof space before leaving a written report.

subject: Pump service window
body: We have a technician available Thursday between noon and two. He will clean the basket and check the timer settings. Please clear the path to the equipment.

subject: Tuesday clinic minibus
body: The minibus will collect residents at the usual entrance at 9.15. We have room for one folding wheelchair and three walking frames. Please confirm the return pickup time.

subject: Frame display refresh
body: The new acetate frames arrived in four colours. I have arranged them by size on the lower display and put the catalogue behind the counter for your team.

subject: Equipment room hours
body: We are opening the equipment room at 7.30 on Monday so the visiting trainers can set up before their class. The usual afternoon timetable is unchanged.

subject: Debate tournament travel
body: The coach leaves at 7.10 from the sports entrance. Pupils should bring lunch and a refillable bottle; the host school will provide water during the afternoon rounds.

subject: Piano recital programme
body: Please list the pieces in performance order and use the composers' full names. The recital starts at 5, with doors open fifteen minutes earlier.

subject: Lane allocation for Saturday
body: The junior squad will use lanes one through three from 8 to 9.30. Masters training moves to the outdoor pool this week because the diving board is being repaired.

subject: Camp equipment list
body: We have the tents and cooking pans covered. Could someone bring two extra tarps and a spare mallet? The bus departs the community centre at 8.00 on Saturday.

subject: Costume hem appointments
body: I can alter the blue skirts after class on Wednesday. Please bring the shoes you plan to wear so I can check the finished length while you try them on.

subject: Service booklet proof
body: The family has approved the order of service. I made the requested change to the hymn on page two; could you check the date and venue once more before printing?

subject: Compost bay turning day
body: We will turn the bays at 9 on Sunday. Bring a fork if you have one, and wear boots because the path is muddy after last night's rain.

subject: Maple Avenue paving notice
body: The resurfacing crew starts at the southern end on Monday. Residents can use the library lot during the daytime closure, and the bus stop will move one block north.

subject: Meter reading route
body: The crew will visit the west district between 14 and 18 September. Please confirm the street list is current and that the public notice has gone to the print shop.

subject: Extinguisher service tags
body: The replacement tags are packed with the service forms. We can deliver them with Friday's cylinder pickup if that works for your warehouse team.

subject: Counter display delivery
body: The sunscreen display will arrive in two cartons on Tuesday. Please keep the aisle clear near the front counter so the driver can bring them straight through.

subject: Demo unit return
body: The demonstration monitor can go back in the padded case with its stand detached. The courier label is valid through Friday, and collection is booked for the morning.

subject: Atrium sketch review
body: I have added the upper landing and revised the handrail detail. The drawing is still schematic, but it should be clear enough for our discussion on Thursday.

subject: Boundary peg confirmation
body: The eastern peg is now visible beside the old fence post. We took the readings twice and found them consistent. I will send the marked plan once the office has checked the northing.

subject: French leaflet proof
body: The revised copy reads naturally now. Please keep the product names in English and use the short date format on the contact panel. I will return the marked proof this afternoon.

subject: Paper stock for invitations
body: We have enough ivory laid stock for the order. The test sheet looked clean at the requested weight; please approve the finish so we can schedule the press.

subject: Author event stock
body: The publisher can send 30 copies by the 12th. We will arrange them on the front table and reserve a chair for the signing. Thanks for confirming the evening slot.
